1: # E-commerce-Microservice
2: A Node.js and Express.js-powered ecommerce Microservice application. To connect the various services, RabbitMQ is used.
3: 
4: ## Clone project
5: 
6: ```bash
7: git clone https://github.com/Dev-Elie/E-commerce-Microservice.git
8: cd E-commerce-Microservice
9: ```
10: 
11: ## Install packages for all services
12: ```bash
13: cd auth-service && npm install
14: cd product-service && npm install
15: cd order-service && npm install
16: ```
17: Install packages for the `Auth middleware`, in the root of the project run:
18: 
19: `npm install`
20: 
21: To run RabbitMQ, execute:
22: 
23: `docker run -p 5672:5672 rabbitmq`
24: 
25: ## NOTE: RabbitMQ must be up and running before starting the services.
26: 
27: To run each service, execute:
28: 
29: `npm run dev`
30: 
31: 
32: Have fun learning about Microservices.
